messages:
ivy: quick postmortem follow-up for SEC-6000. two recurring issues: TTL unit mismatch after migrations and audit gaps when rotate/fast paths bypass middleware. need owners for runtime fix, audit/export, runbook, and a verification step so we can close the ticket. tagging folks who offered help.

Tom: I'll take the audit/export work. plan: run a batched scan and emit CSV with key, ttl_seconds, owner_tag, last_write_ts. add alert if anomalies > baseline*3 and retain CSV proofs for compliance. example script I'll iterate on: 
```
redis-cli --scan --pattern "auth:token:*" | xargs -n200 | while read batch; do for k in $batch; do t=$(redis-cli ttl "$k"); if [ "$t" -le 10 -o "$t" -gt 2592000 ]; then echo "$k,$t,$(redis-cli hget "$k" owner)"; fi; done; done > anomalies.csv
```
I'll post perf numbers in SEC-6000.

Grace: I'll own the runtime writer fix. plan: normalize TTL writes to seconds at the library boundary, add guardrail that rejects TTLs outside [10s,30d], and emit a lib-level audit write on token create. gating behind feature flag AUTH_TTL_STRICT. opening PR today: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4210 and adding `ci/ttl-unit` checks. target canary by 2026-04-06.

Linh: ops will draft a concise rotate runbook and prep call. runbook sketch: 1) run Tom's audit to produce CSV; 2) group by service owner; 3) if total > 1500 -> automated rotate job with 24h staggered grace; else targeted manual rotates; 4) after rotate run verification job that compares rotated list with audit write events and emit proof artifact; 5) upload CSV + verification proof to secure bucket and link to SEC-6000. scheduling 30m prep call 2026-03-29 09:00 PT.

Ivy: quick owners + short deadlines:
- GRACE: runtime PR + tests (due 2026-04-06)
- TOM: audit script + CSV + alerting (due 2026-03-31)
- LINH/OPS-ONCALL: runbook + prep call + verification job (prep call 2026-03-29)

ops-oncall: calendar invite sent. runbook will include a verification command example and the kubectl snippet to flip the feature flag in canary: `kubectl set env deploy/auth-writer AUTH_TTL_STRICT=true -n prod`. also adding a default threshold: if rotated_count != audit_event_count -> fail and pause rollout.

infra-bot: SEC-6000 status updated -> follow-ups assigned (automated).

Ivy: please update SEC-6000 as tasks move. final asks: add the one-line runbook convention "TTL must be written in seconds (s) across all writer binaries" and include Tom's Redis snippet. we'll do a 7-day post-deploy review on 2026-04-13 to capture regressions and close the follow-ups. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
